tested_on: A real TP-Link TL-SG1016PE (hardware 3.0, firmware 1.0.0 Build 20210825 Rel.52031) on the maintainer's network: login, logout, system information (model, MAC, IP) and the statistics of all 16 ports (link speeds 100 and 1000 Mbit full duplex, packet counters) were read and passed the plugin contract.

Not tested on hardware: a refused login or full session list on the real switch (simulated), a port going down or up (link events, simulated), half-duplex and 10 Mbit links, other Easy Smart models and firmware.
reviews.notes: Verified on 2026-10-21 on the maintainer's real switch; the code was written with the assistant Claude from the page format of two public projects (check_tplink, essstat) without copying code. Reads two pages and logs out; no writes.
